blockers: PhaseRecorder only opens/appends output on command(drain/flush); no automatic flush, periodic writer or shutdown persistence. Existing stock TTI/Harbor route has no socket command caller. Env alone cannot yield phase evidence.

In-memory event list capped1000000 events, not byte-capped; overflow records error and discards future events. No run-specific filename interpolation or output file chmod in recorder. Persistent path should be unique and permissions explicitly private, which is not established by existing env alone.
Each drain appends all buffered events; no total file size cap. Long normal rungs could overflow before any export.

measurement_scope.generation_share: Can derive host-boundary decode share from complete windows; plugin host work and idle intervals fall between adapter boundaries. Not device time.
measurement_scope.pool_occupancy: Not recorded: request_ids=None; no scheduler used/free KV block counts. Positions/active rows do not establish physical block occupancy with prefix sharing/eviction. Existing serving_memory allocator logs give allocation footprint, not live block occupancy.
measurement_scope.synchronization: benchmark_phases.py uses only host clock/lock/socket/file operations. generator_vllm.py:446-460 binds existing readback identity and completes after existing conversion/readback wait; no extra device synchronization.

conclusion: Storage/artifact route exists, but no complete bounded private automatic recorder route with existing settings. Requires separately authorized model-owned persistence design and host/live confirmation; no wrapper/plugin/workflow changes proposed here. Do not enable env alone expecting evidence.
